methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Roanoke College launches WorkAI Lab to prepare leaders for new era of technology - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College's WorkAI Lab represents distributed capacity-building outside major metros, creating peer learning infrastructure that could spread deep AI fluency through professional networks in mid-sized markets.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Free community AI workshops led by a local native signal grassroots knowledge distribution effort, directly targeting the technology gap through accessible peer learning rather than top-down or platform-mediated adoption.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: VCU's institutional AI partnership concentrates deep technical capability in Richmond Metro, potentially creating a secondary hub but raising questions about whether innovation stays contained in academic-corporate networks or distributes broadly.

signals.title: NoVa lawmakers take AI cash while residents resist data centers - opensecrets.org
signals.signal_reading: NoVA lawmakers receiving AI industry cash while residents resist data centers reveals a disconnect where infrastructure concentrates without community buy-in or distributed benefit, signaling potential for neither depth nor broad adoption.

signals.title: AI pressure grows on Richmond's young workforce - Axios
signals.signal_reading: Pressure on Richmond's young workforce to adopt AI tools suggests platform-driven shallow adoption spreading through employment necessity rather than deep technical capability development, creating broad but surface-level engagement.
